api_list.name: Base Currency Exchange Rates
api_list.description: Get all Exchange Rates (in alphabetical order) for a Base Currency.
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://ziff.p.rapidapi.com/exchangerates/GBP"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "ziff.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
